{{recipesummary|category=Salad recipes|servings=8|time=10 minutes|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] 

==Ingredients==

* 1 can (15 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Pinto Bean|pinto beans]], rinsed and drained
* 1 can (15 oz) [[Cookbook:Kidney Bean|red kidney beans]], rinsed and drained
* 1 can (12 oz) [[Cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]], rinsed and drained
* 1 can (8¾ oz) [[Cookbook:Corn|whole kernel corn]], drained
* 1 can (14½ oz) diced [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]] with roasted [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], undrained
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] fat-free Italian salad dressing
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Italian Seasoning|Italian seasoning]]
* ¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

==Procedure==

# In a bowl, mix together beans, corn, tomatoes, Italian salad dressing, Italian seasoning and pepper.
# Serve chilled or at room temperature.
